points.quote: `defineBlockSchema({ flavour, props, metadata, toModel })` declares the block. `flavour` is a namespaced string such as `'affine:callout'`. ... `metadata` holds `version`, `role` (`'hub'` here)
`metadata` holds `version`, `role` (`'hub'` here) and the `parent` and `children` flavour whitelists, which constrain where the block can sit in the tree.
`class CalloutBlockModel extends BlockModel<CalloutProps>` is the model class.

`CalloutBlockComponent extends CaptionedBlockComponent<CalloutBlockModel>`. This is a Lit element. Its base class comes from the `BlockComponent` family ... `BlockViewExtension('affine:callout', literal\`affine-callout\`)` maps the flavour to a static Lit tag.

`CalloutStoreExtension extends StoreExtensionProvider` ... calls `context.register(...)` with the schema extension and the adapter extensions ... `CalloutViewExtension extends ViewExtensionProvider` ... Both providers are listed in the aggregate lists in `blocksuite/affine/all/src/extensions/store.ts` and `view.ts`. Editor presets pick them up from there.
`effect()` calls `effects()` to define the custom elements.
